description: This Kotlin source file defines the TaskViewModel class, which manages UI state and task operations for a task management app. It interacts with a repository to fetch, add, update, toggle completion, and delete tasks, exposing observable StateFlow properties for UI binding.

classes.name: TaskViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing the list of tasks, handling user interactions, and maintaining UI state for a task organizer app.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task with the specified title and optional description, updating the task list and handling validation.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID with new title and optional description.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task by ID.

methods.name: openAddDialog
methods.description: Prepares the ViewModel state to open a dialog for adding a new task.

methods.name: openEditDialog
methods.description: Prepares the ViewModel state to open a dialog for editing an existing task.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes any open dialog and resets editing state.
